independence.fixture_generation_method: Hand-authored by the model from URI's intended office-work role and the approved plan's protocol sections; candidate objects hand-authored, file candidates shaped after uri_core/core/file_store.py StoredFile.to_reference(); a pure data-transform script (outside the repository, importing nothing from it) converted the draft to this schema and validated internal consistency. No TurnFrame, RAR, benchmark, or model execution.
allowed_sources: uri_core/core/file_store.py (StoredFile fields, to_reference(), file_id generation only)
blind_sources: all existing RAR fixture files (rar_fixtures.py, rar_challenge_fixtures.py, rar_stage3_blind_fixtures.py, rar_stage4b_independent_fixtures.py, rar_adversarial_fixtures.py)
all prior RAR stage reports and manifests
prohibited_sources: TurnFrame builder source and pattern lists
existing RAR benchmark fixtures and case text
RAR lexical/scoring rules and cascade levels
independence.known_indirect_exposure: The approved plan (sections 8-10, which the author read before the full task prompt arrived) states second-hand facts about the implementation: a 21-pattern Step-1 vocabulary exists (patterns not shown); the real wired recency field only takes a 'same'-type value or none; a later resolver stage was taught to use words such as latest/current/previous; per-reference negation and type hints are not derived in production. No pattern list, regex, or resolver code was seen. See the authoring report, section 11.

harness_input_contract.C3_derivation: C3 is not authored. The harness derives it by giving a case no candidates. Expected C3 outcome: UNKNOWN for every reference in cases that have references; NO_REFERENCE for K cases.

field_notes.expected_outcome: RESOLVED | AMBIGUOUS | UNKNOWN | NO_REFERENCE per reference. Variant-level expected_outcome is MULTI_REFERENCE when a case has more than one reference; read expected_by_reference then.
field_notes.intended_candidate_ids: RESOLVED: the target (several if plural_reference is true). AMBIGUOUS: the set of equally valid candidates. UNKNOWN / NO_REFERENCE: empty.
field_notes.acceptable_alternatives: Outcomes a reasonable human reviewer would also accept. Score separately from the primary expectation.
field_notes.ground_truth_references: Human annotation of user intent, for the oracle condition only: the span a careful reader would mark (null when the reference has no surface words), intended object type, temporal meaning, and exclusions that apply to that reference only. Vocabulary is the author's, not any resolver's.
field_notes.temporal_meaning: none | most_recent | one_before_most_recent | earlier_not_latest | earliest | last_discussed | one_before_last_discussed
field_notes.candidate_library: file_reference_shape: file_reference holds exactly the four StoredFile.to_reference() fields; benchmark_added fields (created_at from StoredFile, object_type derived from media_type) are benchmark additions. synthetic_minimal: no real URI object model exists for these; smallest metadata the scenario needs.
field_notes.C1: Clean pool: the intended candidate(s), plus only the same-kind siblings the situation itself depends on (e.g. both minutes files for a 'latest' case, all equally valid candidates for an ambiguity case).
field_notes.C2: Realistic pool: C1 plus plausible distractors (same type, overlapping title words, nearby time, same person name).
